description: This Java interface defines API endpoints for managing documents within the Fineract project, including creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating documents, as well as downloading associated files.

classes.name: DocumentsApiFixed
classes.description: Interface for document-related API operations in Fineract, including create, delete, retrieve, list, and update documents, as well as download files.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document using multipart form upload, requiring entity type, entity ID, file data, and optional name and description.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specified document by entity type, entity ID, and document ID.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads the binary file associated with a specific document.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of a specific document.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Lists all documents associated with a specific entity.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document using multipart form upload, with optional file, name, and description.
